title: Future forms: negatives and questions
intro: Read this before the questions on will, going to and the future continuous and perfect.

blocks.title: will
items: **Negative:** subject + **will not (won't)** + base verb: I **won't tell** anyone.
will never takes -s, -ing or to: *She won't goes*, *Will she to go?* and *Do you will help?* are all wrong.

blocks.title: be going to
items: **Negative:** subject + **am / is / are** + not + **going to** + base verb: It **isn't going to** rain.
**Question:** **Am / Is / Are** + subject + **going to** + base verb: **Are** you **going to** buy it?
**Use:** a plan, or something we can see is about to happen.

blocks.title: future continuous and future perfect
items: **Future continuous:** She **won't be working**. **Will** she **be working**?
**Future perfect:** They **won't have finished**. **Will** they **have finished**?
Only will moves. **be** and **have** stay behind the subject.

blocks.title: after if, when, until
items: After **if, when, as soon as, before, until**, use the PRESENT, even in negatives: If you **don't hurry**, you will miss the bus. Not *If you won't hurry*.
I won't leave until you **arrive**. Not *until you will arrive* and not *until you don't arrive*.

builds: Perfect tenses: negatives, questions and little words
